name: com.sgonzalezrozo.ui-tweens
description: Tween library for Unity UI (uGUI): fluent DOTween-style API for RectTransform, Image and CanvasGroup, with sequences, loops, 33 easings and per-component control. Runs on LeoECS.

samples.description: A self-contained demo that builds its own canvas and animates several UI elements.
Runs allocation and capacity scenarios and writes JSON benchmark reports.
